requirements.description: Current fiscal-year Compustat annual financial data for the KS GMM construction, baseline EM/EQ firm-years, positive-net-income and market-value sample screens. The paper gives legacy item numbers; current fields are candidate semantic mappings only.

required_coverage.frequency: annual firm-year; fiscal-year labels with actual firm fiscal-year-end datadate
required_coverage.population: Compustat firms in two-digit SIC × fiscal-year KS cells (minimum 10 observations), plus the positive-net-income large-sample firm-years in 1991–2001
required_coverage.detail: Support outcome years t=1991–2001. Previous-two-year GMM instruments plus the equation’s own t−1 components require raw fiscal-year data 1988–2001 (1991 minus 36 months through 2001). Year labels are fiscal years, not filing years.

routes.mapping_notes: Candidate field mappings by catalog labels include net income, total assets, operating cash flow, revenue, receivables, tax refund, operating income before depreciation, current assets/liabilities, cash, tax payable, depreciation, gross PP&E, shares, price, special items, fiscal year and historical SIC. The source identifies legacy Compustat item numbers; those numbers are not assigned to local fields by resemblance, so exact provider item mapping and vintage semantics remain unverified.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Exact fields are readable, but no local coverage confirmation proves the 1988–2001 firms, fiscal years or year×SIC cell population. Legacy item-number correspondence to current fields remains unverified.

variable_coverage.construction: Construct ACCL_t/TA_(t−1) from statement-of-cash-flows total accruals, then scale by prior-year total assets. The paper defines ACCL as net income minus operating cash flow and cites historical Compustat items #172 and #308; exact current field equivalence is not verified.

Construct (REV_t/TA_(t−1))×(ART_(t−1)/REV_(t−1)); ART is accounts receivable less tax receivables. Appendix B defines legacy items #12, #6, #2 and #161; current field mapping is not inferred from numeric/name resemblance.

Construct (EXP_t/TA_(t−1))×(OCAL_(t−1)/EXP_(t−1)); EXP is revenue less operating income before depreciation; OCAL is current assets less ART, cash and tax refund, less current liabilities net of taxes payable. Exact current field mapping is unverified.
Construct (GPPE_t/TA_(t−1))×(DEP_(t−1)/GPPE_(t−1)); source defines gross PP&E and income-statement depreciation using historical Compustat numbers. Exact current field mapping is unverified.
Use the residual ε_t from the supporting KS GMM fit for the same fiscal-year/two-digit-SIC cell, retaining negative residuals.
ROA is same-fiscal-year net income divided by total assets at the beginning of that fiscal year (prior fiscal-year assets).

Select the median I/B/E/S long-term earnings-growth forecast from the last month of each firm fiscal year and map it to the Compustat firm-year. Exact measure code and historical crosswalk are unresolved.

evidence.quote: Financial data for estimating discretionary accrual are obtained from Compustat during 1988–2001.
evidence.description: Compustat source and raw support period.

evidence.quote: we run a regression using GMM in each year and two-digit SIC code category if there are 10 observations or more in that category.
evidence.description: KS method, fit cells and minimum cell size.

evidence.quote: The dependent variable and independent variables in previous 2 years are used as instrumental variables for GMM estimation.
The amount of managed earnings is the error term from the model.
Our total accruals are calculated from statement of cash flow.
We use the median of long-term growth forecasts in the last month of each fiscal year.
The sample only includes firm years with positive net income.
The GAO database includes company name, ticker symbol, the date of the announcement, the entity that prompted the restatement, and the reason(s) for the restatement.
Based on GAO’s report, we hand collect the available restated fiscal year and restated amount of earnings from the firms’ restatement announcements on Lexis–Nexis.
evidence.description: Hand-collected annual values and affected fiscal years.

evidence.quote: We require each observation to have a clearly specified amount of restated annual net income, positive reported earnings and negative earnings restatements
The final sample includes 91 firm years with 67 different firms.
we replace LG as industry median LG if the firm specific LG is not available.
ART = Accounts receivable (#2) less Tax receivables (#161)
EXP = expenses = Revenue (#12)- Operating income before depreciation (#13)
